rationale: UC2 retains the experiment-wide W450-O75 technical chunking reference rather than tuning chunk size on UC2 content.
UC2 is mixed-media, therefore the provenance boundary is generalized from physical PDF pages to deterministic source units.
PDF source units remain physical pages.
HTML source units remain acquired authoritative HTML components.
No chunk crosses a source-unit boundary.
The excluded DOC054 artifact cannot contribute runtime chunks.
